# Unconstrained

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders its child outside the flow: the child draws from the current cursor position but consumes no height, so whatever follows starts where the child started.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.
